case.title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG. Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor. Need: 6110 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 36 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200002. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70510.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Petra Lechner,

Thank you for explaining the cost movements behind your quotation. We recognise that copper represents genuine cost pressure at the weight you have indicated, alongside rising labour and steel costs.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).

Our analysis supports the fixed-price packages below as a clear proposal for your pricing committee, with price certainty supporting our continued business together. We are flexible on payment terms; which package works best for you?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 350.66 per unit, payment 90 days net, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 346.01 per unit, payment 30 days net, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 347.16 per unit, payment 45 days net, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We value our long-term relationship with Nordmark and appreciate your consideration of this proposal.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Furthermore, we have reviewed your updated volume forecast and incorporated the increased quantities into our calculation.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €373.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. Based on the higher volume and maintaining our standard 30 days net payment terms, we can offer a revised price of EUR 369.76 per unit at standard terms (a price of €369.76 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel).

Regarding your request, our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. However, our colleagues will provide the requested information regarding the cost breakdown shortly. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Petra Lechner,

Thank you for validating our higher demand forecast, incorporating it into your calculation and reducing your offer. We recognise the genuine copper pressure and note your preference for standard payment terms and your position on keeping the calculation confidential.

We are making a modest price concession, but the proposal below retains extended payment terms rather than your requested standard terms. In exchange for this price step, we ask you to narrow the remaining price gap on the fixed-price, no-index basis you offered, providing a clear package for your pricing committee.

We propose: EUR 352.15 per unit, payment 90 days net, fixed price, no index clause.

We appreciate your efforts and value the continuity of our relationship.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
